answer: Re-attestations are stored in jetty and vault lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the copper graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1904 impostors cost 615 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear.
